verdict.rationale: Channel3 has no general scheduler for recurring jobs or workflows. The closest feature is price tracking: you subscribe to a product and Channel3 monitors it on an ongoing basis, sending webhook notifications when the price changes. The CLI can also be called from scripts, so recurring runs would need an external scheduler such as cron. Missing for 10: a native user-defined schedule or cron for searches and workflows, scheduling of arbitrary jobs, documentation of the price-tracking cadence or controls, and independent corroboration.
